summary: Provisional patient, PA expiry tracking, and a set of patient tracking reliability fixes.

updates.title: Provisional Patient
updates.body: Provisionally enrolled patients now appear in Patient Tracking behind a default-hidden filter, tagged as "provisional" for easy identification. They are excluded from the Journey Board and geography-based role restrictions, and brand lookup resolves across multiple data sources without requiring an exact match.

updates.title: PA Expiry Column & Filter
updates.body: A new Prior Authorization Expiry column and filter in Patient Tracking lets teams quickly spot upcoming PA lapses before they occur.

updates.title: Journey Board Status History
updates.body: Journey Step and Issue Group columns are now available in the Status History tab on the Patient Profile, giving teams more context on a patient's progression.

updates.title: Hub Patient ID Tooltip
updates.body: The Hub Patient ID label now includes a tooltip showing the earliest and latest Hub Patient IDs associated with a patient.

updates.title: Patient Tracking Export
updates.body: Resolved an issue where duplicate patient records appeared across paginated pages in exports.

updates.title: Patient Tracking Filters & Columns
updates.body: Primary Affiliation now appears for HCPs from data source; Current HCP Name, HCP NPI, and Primary HCO columns populate correctly; the Referral Source filter now returns only patients whose latest source matches the selection; and the Add button behaves correctly when clicked away.

updates.title: Journey Board Date Collision
updates.body: The Journey Board now resolves same-date status collisions to the lowest-rank Issue Group, with Issue Group rank visible in Status History.
